title: The Lost Sheep
description: Jesus tells the parable of the shepherd who leaves the ninety-nine sheep to search for the one that is lost, and rejoices when he finds it. In the same way, there is joy in heaven over one sinner who repents.

versions.title: The Lost Sheep
versions.description: A shepherd leaves 99 sheep to search for the one lost sheep, and great joy fills heaven.
versions.reason: [minor] slug: The slug has a spelling error: 'faret' should be 'faaret' without using å. Correct transliteration is 'faaret' or better 'sauen'.; [minor] title: 'The Lost Sheep' is unusual in Norwegian; 'The Lost Sheep' or 'The Lost Flock' is more common.
